title: Data Workbench Live Hydration & Map
category: Professional SaaS / data quality / Workbench UX
summary: Hardens the Professional Data Workbench after live-use review. The retired Developer Access view-as switcher is removed globally; Workbench rows now automatically re-check the normalized property warehouse and NJOGIS Parcels/Mod-IV source when they load; newly selected fields trigger a fresh hydration pass; additional source fields such as owner name, mailing context, deed fields, property use, building class and parcel dates are resolved when the user's plan permits them; the field library is organized by category with understated plan-level rails and higher-plan fields disabled; and an interactive synchronized parcel map can be opened directly from the Workbench.

items.detail: Removed the Developer Access / View As switcher and legacy stored plan override. Developer accounts now use their actual Developer entitlement without a floating overlay.

Added authenticated workbench-hydrate v3. Every loaded Workbench row is checked by PAMS PIN against the normalized property warehouse plus the NJOGIS Parcels/Mod-IV Composite, and current marker observations are merged automatically.
The hydrator resolves available parcel, assessment, tax, sale, building, owner, mailing, deed and parcel-publication fields from authoritative source records when requested and permitted by plan.

Field Library entries are grouped into Property Record, Parcel, Assessment, Tax, Sales, Building, Appeal Intelligence, Flood & Environment, Watchdog Intelligence, Ownership, Permits, Market, Finance and Risk. Plan level is shown as a simple right-edge rail; higher-plan fields remain visible but greyed and disabled.

Added a Leaflet/OpenStreetMap Workbench map using current warehouse coordinates. Loaded properties are plotted, selected records are visually emphasized, and clicking a map point selects the matching Workbench row.
Workbench no longer assumes the sparse saved-properties or Opportunity Desk row is the complete property record. Missing source values remain explicitly Not available rather than being fabricated.
